test_item:
DebugAuth just logs an error, if verification or ID check failed.
(AuthData verification fails; the installed AuthData is retained)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. AuthData is already installed on the DUT
3. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
4. A USB drive containing an AuthData package with a mismatching signature is available
proc:
1. Record the installed AuthData before the verification attempt
$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth
2. Clear the log buffer before the verification attempt
$ adb logcat -c
3. Insert USB drive containing the invalid AuthData package into HU USB port
4. Record the installed AuthData after the verification attempt
$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth
er:
1. The adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth output lists the installed AuthData
2. The adb logcat -s logdog output is empty before the attempt
3. PENDING: X-h log keyword
4. The adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth output lists the same installed AuthData as in step 1
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-SAM-0004 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria 3.1 and 3.2 (logdog assertion)
ER 3 is PENDING: the logdog keyword for this scenario is not given verbatim in the delivered material
channel_feasible = N (trace_summary 4b)
